prompt:
Build the one-page web site for the conference described in content.json, replacing the placeholder index.html. It must be a polished, production-quality page that a designer would be happy to ship.

Constraints: static files only (index.html plus any CSS, JS and image files you add), opened from a plain static file server with index.html as the entry point. No build step, no frameworks, no CDNs, web fonts or any request to another site. Use all the content from content.json (you may copy it into the HTML or load it at runtime).

Requirements:
1. Header with the event name as the only h1, the tagline, dates and venue, and a site navigation with in-page links to the Schedule, Speakers, Tickets and Register sections.
2. On screens narrower than 768px the navigation links are hidden behind a button whose accessible name is "Menu". It has aria-expanded="false" when closed and "true" when open, and toggles the links on click. Pressing Escape while the menu is open closes it and moves focus back to the button. At 768px and wider the links are always visible and the Menu button is not shown.
3. Schedule: one tab per day following the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern: a role="tablist", tabs with role="tab" whose accessible names are exactly "Day 1", "Day 2" and "Day 3", aria-selected, aria-controls pointing at the role="tabpanel". Only the selected day's panel is visible; Day 1 is selected at first. Clicking a tab selects it. With focus on a tab, ArrowRight and ArrowLeft select and focus the next and previous tab, wrapping around at the ends, and Home and End select and focus the first and last tab. Each session shows its time, title and speaker.
4. Speakers: one card per speaker with the name as an h3, plus role and company.
5. Tickets: one card per ticket with its name, price in euros written like "€299" and summary, and a button labelled "Choose Standard", "Choose Student" or "Choose Team". Choosing a ticket selects it in the registration form and moves focus to the form's "Full name" field.
6. Register: a form with fields labelled "Full name" (required), "Email" (required, must be a valid address), "Ticket" (a select of Standard, Student and Team) and "Team size" (a number from 3 to 20). The Team size field is shown and required only while Team is selected, and hidden otherwise. A live total below the fields shows the price, for example "Total: €299" for Standard and "Total: €747" for a team of 3. The submit button is labelled "Register". Validate in JavaScript and send nothing over the network. On submit with invalid fields: show no success message, set aria-invalid="true" on each invalid field, show a visible error message for each one referenced by the field's aria-describedby, and move focus to the first invalid field. When valid: show a role="status" message that contains "You're registered" and the email address.
7. Follows the reader's light or dark preference (prefers-color-scheme) with WCAG AA contrast in both, fits phones from 320px wide with no sideways scrolling, has visible keyboard focus styles and respects prefers-reduced-motion.

When you are done the page must work in a current Chrome with no console errors.
